headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty fell for the eighth straight week, marking the longest losing run in 25 years.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 5 October.

why: Persistent FII selling and global cues weighed heavily on investor sentiment
Expectations of a 0.25% RBI rate hike in the upcoming October policy due to inflation
Geopolitical tensions as Iran warns of closing the Strait of Hormuz
Record bear run marking the longest weekly losing streak in over two decades
whatHappening: Sensex dropped 570.59 points while Nifty fell to 22,421.95 in the last session
NSE-listed companies faced a market capitalization erosion of approximately Rs 5 trillion
Flipkart doubled its active seller base over the last 15 months
FSSAI recalled Everest Cumin Powder and suspended Creative Bakers' license for safety violations
summary: The Indian stock market is closed for the weekend after the last session saw the Sensex and Nifty extend their losing streak to eight weeks. This record bear run, the longest in 25 years, was driven by heavy FII selling and concerns over a potential 0.25% RBI rate hike. Investors are now looking toward Monday's reopening for signs of recovery or further volatility.
